subject: Complete the traceability manifest: capability entries for every refinement and release evidence bound to commits and working-tree hashes
description:
WHY: loomrefinements.md §Repository language (a machine-readable engineering manifest) and §Source-of-truth ("Register a descriptive capability for every retained and added behavior … The release evidence binds repository commits and working-tree hashes").

FROM TASK 8 (the contract; names are final):
- CapabilityRegister entries have optional owner (Alias), negativeVerification (case ids, minItems 1), proofLimits (Text), environments (EnvironmentKind[], minItems 1, unique) and evidenceRefs (Id[], minItems 1). `verification` stays the positive cases. This task makes coverage --check require them for every entry (decision 10) in the same change that fills every entry.
- ReleaseEvidence (assurance.schema.json): releaseEvidenceVersion 1; candidate [{repositoryPath: RelativePath ('.' for the root), commit: 40-hex, workingTreeHash: Hash over tracked and untracked candidate content, clean}] keyed by repositoryPath; contractDigest; runRefs (runIds, unique, at least one). This task produces it.
- Task 8 added the entry `contract.qualification-run` (qualification/capabilities.json now holds 131 entries).

GROUNDING:
- qualification/capabilities.json held 123 entries on 2026-10-03, each with id, description, code, contract and verification.
- coverage --check resolves code, contract and passed cases (packages/cli/src/coverage.ts:56-83, :98-128, :149-192). Cases are named `<pkg>.<file-stem>.<slug>`, `core.selftest.<section>` or `qualification.check.<id>`.

CHANGE:
- Fill owner, positive and negative tests, proof limits, required environments and the evidence reference for every entry, retained and new. Each task added its new entries; this task checks they are complete.
- coverage --check enforces the new fields. Update fixtures/capability-register.json.
- Generate a coverage view with readable requirement names.
- Release evidence records bind repository commit plus working-tree hash, so another session's simultaneous edits cannot qualify a different candidate.
- Positive and negative cases for the new coverage checks.

AREA TESTS: npm run build; node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern "coverage" packages/cli/dist/test/cli.test.js; node packages/cli/dist/index.js coverage --check (the full --results run comes in task 28).
WORKER: Sonnet, fresh.
